title: Climate Change Act 2021 (Act No. 43 of 2021)
citation: Climate Change Act 2021 (Act No. 43 of 2021), assented 23 September 2021; commencement by notice under s 1(2); LN 19 of 2025
evidence: Legal Notice No. 19 of 2025 (Commencement Notice): "I hereby appoint 4 April 2025 as the commencement date for Parts 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 13, 14, 16 and 17 of the Climate Change Act 2021." Opened 2026-11-03 at https://www.laws.gov.fj/api/show_pdf_lawsaspublished/1754. The consolidation's Table of Amendments says the same: "commenced on 4 April 2025 (Pts 1-4, 6-9, 12-14, 16-17)" (https://www.laws.gov.fj/api/retrieve_html/LOF.CAP106B.CCAFJ21.BODY).
notes: Mapped to F2 (framework act); the existing register row carried F3. F3 content: s 31 (mandatory, biennial reporting by fuel importers on fuel sold, to the permanent secretary for transport) and s 32 (facility-level emissions reporting above a prescribed quantity, which the text makes voluntary: "may keep and biennially provide"), both in Part 7, in force. The brief expected a mandatory facility duty; the text does not say so. Not commenced per the Table of Amendments (consolidation last updated 04 August 2026): Parts 5, 10 (carbon sequestration property rights and emissions reduction projects, ss 45-64), 11 and 15 (private sector, ss 92-100, which includes s 96, disclosure of climate financial risks by companies and managed investment schemes, and s 94, directors' duty to consider climate risks). Only the 2025-04-04 notice was found; no later commencement notice is in the Laws as Published list. Carbon market regulations: none gazetted (see register.csv, F7 row). The adopted record is the Act as published (PDF, pdftotext -layout); the consolidated record is the laws.gov.fj section-by-section text; both are dated 2025-04-04, the first date any part was in force, because the site serves one consolidation only. Languages: English only. Acts are enacted in English; the Laws as Published list (toc_lawsaspublished, 449 Acts and 1510 Legal Notices, all with Language 'English') and the consolidation serve no iTaukei or Hindi text of this instrument, and no government English translation is needed.
